source_document.title: Just One KISS - Owner Site Boot Plan
source_document.role: Ready-to-build preparation plan for the private owner-facing site and downstream public-site spokes.

content_summary: Defines the owner-site boot target, initial modules, priority-surface first visible board, minimum record schema, implementation boot sequence, public-site spokes, visual/brand rules, and readiness questions.

initial_application_modules.primary_outcome: Readiness, red flags, next actions, and July 25, 2026 launch focus.
initial_application_modules.timeline_rule: GEN cards; linked records keep their own IDs.

initial_application_modules.primary_outcome: Create and edit all Timeline Moment ID families and GEN records.
Stage docs/cue.txt as proposed records without finalizing the setlist.
initial_application_modules.timeline_rule: Assign proposed IDs before show-ready use.

initial_application_modules.primary_outcome: Catalog physical and digital evidence with condition, content, and uses.
Convert uploads into media and asset records.
Surface unknown, needs-review, venue-dependent, reference-only, unsafe, or prohibited records.
Track build, rehearsal, venue, marketing, booking, and review work.
initial_application_modules.timeline_rule: GEN unless tied to a specific moment.

initial_application_modules.primary_outcome: Draft public pages and CTAs from approved data only.
initial_application_modules.timeline_rule: Pages usually GEN; embedded records keep IDs.

initial_application_modules.primary_outcome: Generate run sheets, emergency sheets, packing lists, and rehearsal checklists.

boot_sequence: Load inventory, rig, and vendor-manual SSOT files
Gate public output behind public/private, content, and safety fields

maintenance.update_rule: When the human-readable source changes, update this SSOT JSON and docs/ssot/master_index.json in the same change.

priority_surface_addendum.first_visible_surface: Source-backed owner priority board inside the command shell.

drop_metadata_rules.Now: Normally set status to in_progress or ask whether it is only accepted as not_started.
drop_metadata_rules.Finished: Require closing note or confirmation that no next action remains.
drop_metadata_rules.Delete: Move to recovery bin before permanent deletion.

visual_brand_rules.visual_thesis: Dark backstage cockpit: theatrical enough for Just One KISS, calm enough for real owner work.
